plain: The way institutions serve people simply because they cannot run without people's work, taxes and cooperation.
eli5: The bakery is nice to you because it needs you to buy bread. If it stopped needing customers, it would have no reason to be nice.
technical: In Kulveit et al. (2025), the alignment of societal systems with human interests that results from their dependence on human labour and participation, as distinct from explicit mechanisms such as voting and consumer choice.
